claim_text: The safety and wellbeing of our employees, contractors and communities is core to our values, and to what we stand for as a company. Nothing matters more.
metric_name: Fatalities at managed operations; All-injury frequency rate; Potential fatal incidents
context_text: The safety and wellbeing of our employees, contractors and communities is core to our values, and to what we stand for as a company. Nothing matters more.；Tragically, in August 2025, our colleague Mohamed Camara was fatally injured while changing a heavy mobile equipment tyre at the SimFer mine site in Guinea.；We recorded 87 potential fatal incidents (PFIs) during the year.；Fatalities at managed operations 1 (2024: 5 fatalities).；All-injury frequency rate (AIFR) at 0.37 (target: 0.38). (2024: 0.37).
label: Partially Supported
rationale_short: 报告确有安全绩效数据和管理行动，但FY2025仍发生1起死亡事故且有87起潜在致命事件，无法充分支撑“Nothing matters more”这一强烈结果性表述，存在夸大漂绿嫌疑。
notes: 证据合并自社会章节与2025 performance against sustainability targets。
